components.name: 编辑页签
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button aria-expanded="true">构图与机位</button><button>运镜</button><button>表演与摆位</button><button>叙事与衔接</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#212327;padding:6px 12px}.ds-tabs button{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-size:13px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:#a6a9ad}.ds-tabs button[aria-expanded=true]{color:#d9b780;background:#35312a;border-color:#65563d}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#373b40}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d9b780;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: 镜头时间线
components.css: .ds-shots{display:flex;gap:3px;background:#212327;padding:6px}.ds-shots button{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-size:13px;padding:7px 8px;background:#2a2d31;color:#e4e5e3;border:1px solid #42454a;border-radius:5px}.ds-shots button[aria-current]{background:#40382b;border-color:#d9b780;color:#f1d3a0}.ds-shots button:hover{background:#373b40}.ds-shots button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d9b780;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: 中心 3D 场景承担主要任务，深色工具界面与较亮白模画面区分操作区和拍摄内容。延续既有颜色与系统字体；本次只调整工作区组织，不引入新的视觉身份或素材。没有装饰性入场动画。
